limits: The output establishes one successful bounded control action; it does not close D91/T01 or demonstrate other Records controls.

The raw receipt intentionally omits the actual request body and response contents. Confidence comes from the exact assertions in the driver source plus the terminal successful run and matching downloaded receipt, rather than independently inspectable payload bytes.

Backend /health/version was sampled immediately after the terminal at SHA 88fbdae6fb22e43d7bef8c4641d54372ca7af4a3; no before/after bracket surrounds the request, so exact backend source during execution is unverified.

findings.finding: The producer assertions are strong and were checked: request body is exact; completion is parsed from that same Network request ID; rendered output is deep-equal to full_result; an incorrect stage throws and prevents passed status. However, retained evidence stores only booleans/counts, not a digest of the canonical request body or completion, so a later reviewer cannot independently recompute the correlation from the receipt.
findings.why_it_matters: The run is credible bounded live evidence, but retained evidence is not independently replayable at the payload/result level. Preserve privacy while retaining stable digests and correlation identifiers if the acceptance needs stronger archival evidence.

findings.finding: The post-run backend SHA is not a bracketed deployed-source identity. A fresh read-only GitHub secret-name listing independently confirms MATRX_PREPARE_ADMIN_CREDENTIALS_JSON and MATRX_PROFILE_APPROVED_ORGANIZATION_JSON are absent now; this cannot prove their pre-run absence or deletion timing. Secret values were not read.
findings.why_it_matters: Do not elevate these fields into claims about exact backend revision or complete secret lifecycle chronology.
